lines.text: Paul went to Troas to preach the gospel, but had no peace because he did not find Titus there.
Paul said goodbye to the people in Troas and went on to Galatia.
Paul says he and his team are the aroma of Christ, a fragrance of life to some and death to others.
Paul says the Corinthians are a letter from Christ, written with the Spirit on tablets of human gold.
Paul says their competence comes from God, who qualified them as ministers of a new covenant of the Spirit.
